# Vulnerability Report Template

Use this template when reporting a security vulnerability through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Betta-Pay/BettaPay-Contract/security/advisories/new)
(preferred) or by emailing **security@bettapay.com**.

Do not open a public GitHub issue for a security vulnerability. See
[`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) at the repository root for the full reporting
policy, disclosure timeline, and the list of report owners.
